title: Acceptance Receipt v1
description: Gate verdict receipt with closed status enum (ACCEPTED/REJECTED/ERROR). Caller-owned; captures reducer output and ledger binding. Payload-envelope does not self-hash: all WireDigest fields are at root level, payload contains no self-referential fingerprints. Per 02-evidence-receipt-and-ledger.md §3.

invocationKey.description: Ledger-unique invocation key; uniqueness constrained by (ledgerId, invocationKey)

invocationKeyFP.description: TypedFP('rg.gatea.invocation-key.v1', { ledgerId, invocationKey }) as WireDigest. Cross-ledger isolation via domain-labeled FP.

status.description: Closed terminal decision status. Per §12.3 R3: domain unknown rejection via target schema enum. NON_RELEASE is not a valid target status.

issuedAt.description: Receipt issuance timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC

issuerId.description: Principal ID of the caller who owns and holds this receipt
